senses.exampleCN: 法案在上议院获得通过。

definition_en: the ninth month of the year, between August and October
core_image: 新书包放在门口，树叶刚刚开始变黄
scene: 九月我们回到学校，开始新学期。 In September we go back to school and start a new term.

senses.definition: the ninth month of the calendar year, with thirty days
senses.definitionCN: 公历年的第九个月，有三十天

senses.why: The month keeps an old name meaning seven even though the calendar later pushed it to ninth place.
senses.whyCN: 这个月保留着意为「七」的旧名，尽管历法后来把它推到了第九位。

senses.title: The start of the school year
senses.definition: the month when many schools begin a new term after the summer
senses.definitionCN: 许多学校在暑假后开始新学期的月份
senses.example: The new term begins in September.
senses.why: Holidays end and classes resume, so the month is tied to fresh notebooks and new plans.
senses.whyCN: 假期结束、课程恢复，因此这个月与崭新的本子和新计划绑在一起。

senses.title: The turn from summer to autumn
senses.definition: the month felt as the moment when summer gives way to autumn
senses.definitionCN: 被感受为夏天让位给秋天的那个月
senses.example: The leaves begin to change in September.
senses.why: Cooler air and shorter days mark a visible change, so the month stands at the season's hinge.
senses.whyCN: 更凉的空气和更短的白天带来可见的变化，于是这个月站在季节的铰链上。

definition_en: to get pleasure from something, or to have the use of something good
core_image: 孩子捧着故事书坐在窗边，读到有趣处笑出声
scene: 孩子捧着故事书坐在窗边，读到有趣处笑出声。 The children enjoy the story very much.
sceneCN: 这里 enjoy 是「享受」（第 01 个义项）；句意是孩子们非常享受这个故事。

pos.zh: 动词：享受、享有、过得愉快

senses.title: To take pleasure in
senses.definition: to get pleasure from something
senses.example: The children enjoy the story very much.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们非常享受这个故事。
senses.why: From Old French enjoier, 'give joy', built on Latin gaudere 'rejoice'; the English verb keeps the plain idea of having joy in something.
senses.whyCN: 源自古法语 enjoier「给予快乐」，其根是拉丁语 gaudere「欢欣」；英语这个词保留的就是「从某事中得到快乐」的意思。

senses.title: To have good health
senses.definition: to have the use of something good
senses.definitionCN: 拥有并受益于好的事物
senses.example: She enjoys good health at eighty.
senses.why: The 'have joy in' sense widened to 'have the use of' a good thing, as when someone possesses health or rights.
senses.whyCN: 「从中得乐」的意思扩大为「拥有并使用」某种好的事物，如拥有健康或权利。

senses.title: To have a good time
senses.definition: to have a good time
senses.example: We enjoyed ourselves at the party.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在聚会上玩得很愉快。
senses.why: In enjoy oneself the joy moves from the thing to the person's own experience, so the phrase means to have a good time.
senses.whyCN: 在 enjoy oneself 中，快乐从事物转到人自身的经历，这个短语因此表示玩得开心。

definition_en: the front of the head, or to confront something
core_image: 一张正对镜头的脸，眉、眼、口在光里清晰可见
scene: 他站在门口，脸上的表情在灯下很清楚。 She washed her face with cold water.
sceneCN: 这里 face 是「脸」（第 01 个义项）；句意是她用冷水洗脸。

derivatives.zh: 由 sur- 与 face 复合，义为「表面」
由 face 加 -ial 构成，义为「面部的」
由 face 加 -less 构成，义为「无脸的、匿名的」

senses.title: The front of the head
senses.definition: the front part of the head, from the forehead to the chin
senses.definitionCN: 头部从额头到下巴的正面
senses.example: She washed her face with cold water.
senses.why: Face came from Old French face, from Latin facies, 'form, appearance', and it names the front of the head.
senses.whyCN: face 来自古法语 face，源头是拉丁语 facies「外形、面貌」，指头部的正面。

senses.title: The expression shown on the face
senses.definition: the look or expression that a person shows
senses.definitionCN: 一个人脸上流露的神情
senses.example: His face showed that he was pleased.
senses.exampleCN: 他脸上显出满意的神色。
senses.why: Because feelings appear on the front of the head, the word for that surface also names the expression it carries.
senses.whyCN: 情绪总是显现在头部正面，所以这个表示正面部位的词也指它带有的神情。

senses.title: A front or outer surface
senses.definition: the front or outer surface of an object
senses.example: The face of the cliff was wet with rain.
senses.exampleCN: 悬崖的岩面被雨打湿了。
senses.why: Anything with a front side has a face the way a head does, so the word extends to walls, clocks and cliffs.
senses.whyCN: 任何有正面的事物都像头一样有「脸」，于是这个词扩展到墙面、钟面和崖面。

senses.title: Standing or dignity in others' eyes
senses.definition: the respect or good opinion one has in front of others
senses.definitionCN: 在别人眼里的体面与尊严
senses.example: He lied to save face.
senses.exampleCN: 他为了保全面子撒了谎。
senses.why: The face is what others see, so losing face means losing the good appearance one presents to people.
senses.whyCN: 脸是别人看见的部分，所以 lose face 就是丢掉呈现在众人面前的好样子。

senses.title: To confront or deal with something
senses.definition: to confront a person or thing, or to be turned toward it
senses.definitionCN: 迎面应对某人某物，或朝向它
senses.example: He had to face the truth.
senses.why: To face something is to put your face toward it, so the noun became a verb of confronting or being turned toward.
senses.whyCN: face 某物就是把脸转向它，于是名词转作动词，表示面对或朝向。

senses.definition: Weighing a lot
senses.example: This box is too heavy to lift alone.
senses.exampleCN: 这个箱子太重，一个人抬不动。

senses.whyCN: 古英语 hefig 来自 hebban「举起」；重的东西难以举起。

senses.title: Great in amount or force
senses.definition: Great in amount or force
senses.example: Heavy rain flooded the road.
senses.why: Because a great mass presses down, heavy extends to anything present in large or forceful amount, like rain or traffic.
senses.whyCN: 因为巨大的质量向下压，heavy 引申指数量或力量大的事物，如雨或交通。

senses.title: Hard to bear or do
senses.definition: Hard to bear or do
senses.example: He has a heavy workload.
senses.why: Work that weighs on a person is felt as heavy, so the word also describes duties that are hard to carry.
senses.whyCN: 压在人身上的工作让人感到沉重，所以这个词也形容难以承担的任务。

definition_en: the day of the week between Friday and Sunday
core_image: 全家一起慢下来、开始休息的第一天
scene: 星期六上午我帮妈妈一起打扫房间。 On Saturday morning I help my mother clean the room.
sceneCN: 这里 Saturday 是「星期六」（第 1 个义项：一周中星期五与星期日之间的那一天）；句意：星期六上午我帮妈妈一起打扫房间。

senses.title: The seventh day of the week
senses.definition: the day of the week that comes after Friday and before Sunday
senses.definitionCN: 一周中星期五之后、星期日之前的那一天
senses.example: We visit our grandparents on Saturday.
senses.exampleCN: 我们星期六去看望祖父母。
senses.why: The day is named for Saturn and gives most people a break from work or school.
senses.whyCN: 这一天以农神萨图恩命名，让大多数人从工作或学业中歇下来。

senses.title: The first day of the weekend
senses.definition: the day that opens the weekly rest period in many countries
senses.definitionCN: 在许多国家开启每周休息时段的那一天
senses.example: Saturday is the busiest day at the market.
senses.exampleCN: 星期六是市场最忙的一天。
senses.why: Because many people are free, the name gathers shopping, sport, and family time.
senses.whyCN: 因为很多人有空，这个名字聚集了购物、运动和家庭时光。

senses.title: A day of plans and leisure
senses.titleCN: 安排与休闲中的星期六
senses.definition: the weekday used as a label for leisure plans and weekly events
senses.definitionCN: 用作休闲计划和每周活动标签的星期六
senses.example: Our club meets on Saturday afternoon.
senses.exampleCN: 我们的社团在星期六下午活动。
senses.why: A repeating free day becomes a natural frame for hobbies and gatherings.
senses.whyCN: 循环出现的空闲日自然成为爱好与聚会的框架。

intro.en: Saturday is the day of Saturn, a Roman god who also gave the planet its name.
intro.cn: Saturday 是农神萨图恩之日，这颗行星也以他命名。
